title: Arc button
description: A square-cornered (4px) button in medium weight: a solid primary fill with a small trailing chevron, or a 2px faint outline that floods with the primary colour and turns its label light on hover, over 0.2s.
notes: inside a `dark` wrapper the solid fill takes the theme's dark primary (mint in the arc theme)
name: arc-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: primary fill with a trailing chevron · outline: 2px hairline outline that fills with the primary colour on hover

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 44px (header) · md: 56px (hero and closing band) · full: 36px, stretches to its box (newsletter form)

props.name: chevron
props.description: shows the small chevron after the label (solid buttons show it by default)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
